description: Search Twitch channels, categories, or videos by keyword via Twitch's internal GraphQL (operation SearchResultsPage_SearchResults) — equivalent to the search box at the top of twitch.tv (result views: Channels / Categories / Videos). Returns result cards: channels (login, display name, follower count, live status plus live title/category/viewers), categories (name, slug usable as twitch/get-feed's category, live viewer count, tags), videos (title, URL, channel, view count, publish date). Paginates internally 15 per page up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when fewer results exist than requested. Twitch search exposes no sorting or time filtering, so no such parameters exist. No login or browser required.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword, e.g. "lck" or "league of legends". Plain text, same as the on-site search box. (搜索关键词，与站内搜索框行为一致。)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type — all 3 values: channel = 主播频道/直播 (streamer accounts and live streams, default) / category = 游戏/分类 (games/topics, slug usable by twitch/get-feed's category parameter) / video = 视频 (VODs and uploads). Maps to the GraphQL target index CHANNEL|GAME|VOD.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20). Paginates internally by 15 per page via the response cursor; partial=true when fewer results exist than requested. (返回条数上限，内部自动翻页；结果不足时标记 partial。)
